subject.title: fix(tlon): stop monitor tracking state from growing forever

question: Should Tlon accept the proposed 2,000-entry participation window, after which an old thread requires a fresh bot mention?
rationale: The bound fixes lifetime growth but intentionally changes dispatch behavior for sufficiently old threads, so channel ownership should confirm the tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded window
options.body: Use the 2,000-entry access-refreshed window because it matches the existing Tlon processed-message bound and prevents lifetime growth.

options.title: Retune the policy
options.body: Keep participation bounded but choose a different count or expiry rule and prove the resulting old-versus-recent thread behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded window
recommendation.body: Use the 2,000-entry access-refreshed window because it matches the existing Tlon processed-message bound and prevents lifetime growth.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged Tlon monitor and the thread and invite behavior now being bounded.
